title: SmartCmds
body:
A simple mod to enhance the experience of using commands.

## Commands
**/gm <0-4>** - Changes your current gamemode 
0 = Survival
1 = Creative
~~2 = **Currently broken.**~~
3 = Adventure
4 = Spectator

**/heal** - Heals you completely

**/day, /night, /noon, /midnight** - Changes the time to the correct time respectively

**/suicide** - Kills you

**/rainbowsheep** - Spawns a jeb sheep :P
